archetypes.name: White-Blue Flyers
archetypes.plan: Hold the ground with efficient defenders while flyers and tempo interaction win the race.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Control
archetypes.plan: Trade removal and counterspells for opposing threats, then pull ahead with card draw and evasive finishers.

archetypes.name: Black-Red Sacrifice
archetypes.plan: Pressure life totals, steal a blocker with Act of Treason, and sacrifice it to Vampire Aristocrat.

archetypes.name: Red-Green Ramp
archetypes.plan: Accelerate into large green creatures and use red damage to clear blockers or finish the opponent.

archetypes.name: Green-White Creatures
archetypes.plan: Build a broad creature battlefield, then force favorable blocks with Prized Unicorn or finish with Overrun.
